title: SIXTH LEVEL SPELLS - the 12 sixth level shukenja spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and sohei codes
audit_label: R664 OA sixth level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round fifty-one (capture pp. 143-147): the sixth level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and sohei-usable markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes

banner.title: SIXTH LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 143-147 - the OA sixth level spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read - the 12 sixth level spell stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes (print pp. 143-147; compressed pp. 69-72); all 12 schools, component sets, casting times and saving throws agree, zero contested stat reads. Force shapechange's components read V, S, M in the compressed, the print line cutting at its page boundary - the R660 detect charm pattern. The level runs the widest cast spread in the chapter: three single-segment casts (force shapechange, immunity to weapons, smite) up through longevity's one-day cast, pinned as 8640 segments (60 per turn, 144 turns per day, the turn=60 convention) - and instruct takes three turns, find the path three rounds. Two spells take the half save (force shapechange, smite), longevity the special. Alteration is the most common school at five spells, with the other seven appearing schools exactly once each (no invocation this level). The reversible flags agree between the passes; the sohei-usable marks ride the R658 T62 grid. The stat grid pins as a table: 12 rows the spell ordinals, six columns - school, components (a V=1 S=2 M=4 bitmask), casting time in segments (1 round = 10, 1 turn = 60, 3 turns = 180, 1 day = 8640), saving throw code (0 none, 1 neg., 2 special, 3 half), reversible and sohei markers. The spell names ride the column comments, the prose descriptions close in their own rounds. The table tag L6Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
